voice_settings.note: starting values; the API default for Adam is stability 0.5, similarity 0.75, style 0, speed 1.0. Tune only from the sample: target 140-150 words per minute (about 12 minutes total), speed within 0.92-1.05

context_between_chunks: --context (previous_text and next_text, no extra billed characters) so prosody is continuous across chunk joins
chunking: voice.py default 2,500 characters at paragraph then sentence boundaries: 5 requests for 10,518 characters

preflight_findings.tts_permission: very likely present: an empty-body POST to /v1/text-to-speech/{voice}/with-timestamps was answered with HTTP 422 (text: Field required), not 401 missing_permissions; nothing was generated. Not proven until the first paid call.
preflight_findings.models: models_read is denied, so the list comes from each voice's own model list: eleven_multilingual_v2 (recommended, 1 credit per character), eleven_turbo_v2_5 and eleven_flash_v2_5 (0.5 credit per character, lower quality), eleven_turbo_v2, eleven_flash_v2. eleven_v3 is not listed for these voices.
preflight_findings.pronunciation: a dictionary cannot be created or listed with this key. Option 1: the user creates one in the ElevenLabs web app and gives its id and version (passed as pronunciation_dictionary_locators; not yet an option in yt-voice, a small addition). Option 2: judge by ear in the listening test. The text itself is never edited.
